title: Understanding Singular Values
text: Singular values in PCA represent the amount of variance captured by each principal component. The larger the singular value, the more variance that component captures.

title: Comparing Singular Values
text: Compare the singular values of PC \alpha and PC β. Which one is larger?

title: Determine the Principal Component with Higher Score
text: Given that PC \alpha has a singular value of $$48.42$$ and PC β has a singular value of $$36.31$$, which principal component has a higher component score?
